tools.name: x_amz_bedrock_agentcore_search
tools.description: A special tool that returns a trimmed down list of tools given a context. Use this tool only when there are many tools available and you want to get a subset that matches the provided context.

blockchain.description: Lowercase blockchain protocol symbol, for example btc, eth, or sol.

tools.name: UDA___Get_newest_block_blockheight
tools.description: Returns the highest available block height for a given blockchain, together with the block time. Use this whenever the user asks for the latest, newest, current or tip block height on a chain. This is the version-independent block-height tool: it is backed by whichever API version Lukka currently recommends, so callers do not pin a version. It does not return a block hash. Supported chains, verified live: btc, eth, doge, ltc, xrp. Unsupported chains return "Unsupported crypto symbol: <chain>" - sol, solana, trx, matic and ada all fail, so this is not a chain alias problem. Chain support is per-endpoint and testing thirteen chains found no chain that returns a block height but fails the address endpoints, so do not assume this tool covers more chains than the rest of the server.

blockchain.description: Lowercase blockchain protocol symbol, for example btc or eth.

tools.name: UDA___Get_transaction_for_txhash
tools.description: Returns full decoded detail for a single transaction hash. Use this endpoint when the user supplies a transaction hash, or after listing hashes with get_address_transactions at verbose=0 to decode selected transactions individually.

blockchain.description: Lowercase blockchain protocol symbol, for example btc or eth.

tools.name: UDA___get_address_assets
tools.description: Returns the assets an address holds or has interacted with, as a list of bare asset identifiers - the native asset by code, and tokens by contract address, with no symbol, balance or decimals. Resolve contract addresses separately if you need names. An unsupported chain returns HTTP 200 carrying {"content": "Unsupported crypto symbol: <chain>"}.

address.description: Address to query. Pass the bare address only.

blockchain.description: Lowercase blockchain protocol symbol, for example btc or eth.

block.description: Block number, to return a historical balance as of that block.

asset.description: Asset identifier, to return the balance of a specific token rather than the native asset.

tools.name: UDA___get_address_balance
tools.description: Returns the balance held by an address. Response shape varies by chain: most chains return address, balance as a number, assetType and blockHeight, while some - vet among them - instead return a balances array of asset and balance pairs with balance as a hex string. Chain support is per-endpoint: an unsupported chain returns HTTP 200 carrying {"content": "Unsupported crypto symbol: <chain>"} rather than an error status.

from_block.description: Start block of a block-range filter. Requires to_block.

blockchain.description: Lowercase blockchain protocol symbol, for example btc or eth.

limit.description: Maximum transactions to return, 1 to 1000. Defaults to 50.

to_block.description: End block of a block-range filter. Requires from_block.

asset.description: Filter to transactions involving a specific asset.

to_time.description: End of a time-range filter, ISO 8601. Requires from_time.

from_time.description: Start of a time-range filter, ISO 8601. Requires to_time.

verbose.description: Output verbosity. 0 = transaction hashes only. 1 = key details including value, hash, block height and timestamp (default). 2 = full decoded transaction object per transaction; high latency and response size, use only with a small limit.

get_newest.description: Set to "1" to return the newest transactions first, which reverses both sort order and the limit cutoff. Only "1" is accepted. REQUIRED unless you supply a paired range: the call fails with 404 "get_newest is required if any range isn't specified" when neither get_newest nor a from_block/to_block or from_time/to_time pair is given - reproduced on four addresses across four chains. Mutually exclusive with both range forms, so pass exactly one of the three.

tools.name: UDA___get_address_transactions
tools.description: Returns transactions involving the address. transactionCount is the size of the returned page, not a total match count. Verbosity controls response size: verbose=0 returns hashes only, verbose=1 returns key details (default), verbose=2 returns the full decoded object per transaction - use verbose=2 only with a small limit. Set get_newest=1 for newest-first; it is mutually exclusive with the block and time range filters. Item fields vary by chain - Ethereum items carry fee and amountType, Bitcoin items do not. An unsupported chain returns HTTP 404 with 'Unsupported crypto symbol'.

blockchain.description: Lowercase blockchain protocol symbol, for example btc or eth.

verbose.description: Output verbosity. 1 = block metadata with transaction hashes (default). 2 = block metadata with full decoded transaction objects; high latency and response size.

tools.name: UDA___get_block
tools.description: Returns block information for a given height. Every numeric field appears twice, as the node's hex value and again in decimal with a _decoded suffix - for example number and number_decoded. The time field is epoch milliseconds, unlike Get_newest_block_blockheight which returns an ISO 8601 block_time. verbose=1 (default) returns transaction hashes; verbose=2 returns full decoded transaction objects at materially higher latency and size.

blockchain.description: Lowercase blockchain protocol symbol. Beacon-chain data is Ethereum only.

tools.name: UDA___get_latest_epoch
tools.description: Returns the latest beacon-chain epoch for which data is available, with its slot and timestamp. Use this endpoint to establish the current epoch or slot before querying validator data. Ethereum only.

blockchain.description: Lowercase blockchain protocol symbol. Ethereum only.

slot.description: Slot to read the balance at. Required. Call get_latest_epoch first to obtain a current slot.

tools.name: UDA___get_validator_balance
tools.description: Returns the balance and lifecycle state of an Ethereum beacon-chain validator at a given slot. Balances are in whole ETH, not Gwei. Also returns status, pubkey, withdrawal_credentials and the activation, exit and withdrawable epochs. A very large sentinel value in exit_epoch or withdrawable_epoch means not set - no exit or withdrawal is scheduled. Ethereum only.

blockchain.description: Lowercase blockchain protocol symbol. Ethereum only.

type.description: Which side of the consolidation to return, source or target. Required.

tools.name: UDA___get_validator_consolidations
tools.description: Returns consolidation events for an Ethereum beacon-chain validator, wrapped in a paging envelope, showing where the validator was merged into another or absorbed one. The type parameter is required. Ethereum only.

blockchain.description: Lowercase blockchain protocol symbol. Ethereum only.

from_slot.description: Start slot of a slot-range filter. Requires to_slot.

to_slot.description: End slot of a slot-range filter. Requires from_slot.

tools.name: UDA___get_validator_deposits
tools.description: Returns deposit events for an Ethereum beacon-chain validator, wrapped in a paging envelope. Each event carries epoch, slot_number, slot_time, type, pubkey, signature, withdrawal_credentials and amount. There is no aggregate total, and no transaction hash or source address. Amounts are decimal strings in ETH. Ethereum only.

reward_type.description: Filter to a specific reward type.

blockchain.description: Lowercase blockchain protocol symbol. Ethereum only.

from_slot.description: Start slot of a slot-range filter. Requires to_slot.

to_slot.description: End slot of a slot-range filter. Requires from_slot.

tools.name: UDA___get_validator_rewards
tools.description: Returns reward and penalty events for an Ethereum beacon-chain validator, wrapped in a paging envelope. Each event carries epoch, slot_number, slot_time, type, subtype and amount, plus the attestation components head, target, source, inactivity and inclusion_delay. All amounts are decimal strings in ETH and are negative for penalties. Note that type is the literal 'reward' or 'penalty' - what earned it is in subtype, for example attestation. There is no aggregate total. Ethereum only.

blockchain.description: Lowercase blockchain protocol symbol. Ethereum only.

tools.name: UDA___get_validator_slashing
tools.description: Returns the slashing record for an Ethereum beacon-chain validator. A validator with a clean record returns an empty object - there is no boolean flag, so an empty response means not slashed. Ethereum only.

blockchain.description: Lowercase blockchain protocol symbol. Ethereum only.

from_slot.description: Start slot of a slot-range filter. Requires to_slot. Echoed back in the response as an empty string when unset. Supplying a range also drops validator_id, from_slot and to_slot from the response envelope.

to_slot.description: End slot of a slot-range filter. Requires from_slot. Echoed back in the response as an empty string when unset. Supplying a range also drops validator_id, from_slot and to_slot from the response envelope.

tools.name: UDA___get_validator_withdrawals
tools.description: Returns withdrawal events for an Ethereum beacon-chain validator, wrapped in a paging envelope. Each event carries epoch, slot_number, slot_time, type, to_address, withdrawal_index and amount. There is no aggregate total. Amounts are decimal strings in ETH. This tool takes no limit parameter, so an unfiltered call returns the validator's entire withdrawal history - use from_slot and to_slot to bound it. Ethereum only.
